profile.headline: Actuarial Intern at AAIS (American Association of Insurance Services)

positions.title: Actuarial Intern
positions.description: - Contributed to countrywide filings (loss costs, endorsements, etc.) for various LOBs including Mobile-Homeowners, Homeowners, Dwelling Properties, Commercial Properties, Commercial Liability, Boatowners - Developed and documented reusable Python workflows and Excel template files for recurring actuarial analyses, increasing efficiency and accuracy - Led weekly intern touchbase meetings during summer 2026 - Co-lead teams to back-to-back 1st place victories in the annual company fitness competition

positions.title: Co-Founder & Developer
positions.description: - Led the full-stack development of two prototypes of two software prototypes - Collaborated on a team of 3 to create a 2-page proposal and 10-page feasibility plan - Presented in an expo and formal presentation settings throughout Bradley's Big Idea competition - 2nd place Bradley Big Idea Competition 2025 Overall, winning $4,000 - 1st place Bradley Big Idea Competition 2025 Expo

positions.title: AI Training Data Reviewer
positions.description: - Reviewed answers to Mathematics questions for accuracy, completeness, and quality - Answered Mathematics questions while describing my entire thought process start-to-finish

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.description: - Directly supported floors of 25-35 residents and indirectly supported a building of around 250 residents - Created and ran successful floor programs to engage residents - Mentored and helped train new Resident Advisors

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description: - Guided tutees through the learning process through question-based tutoring - Mentored new tutors to help reach comfortability and confidence when tutoring - Received feedback from tutees about courses passed due to my tutoring - Achieved CRLA Level 1 certification in August 2024

organizations.name: Activities Council of Bradley University
organizations.description: As a marketing coordinator with a concentration on photo and video, I would take pictures at events, manage our digital organization of images, select images to upload to recap our events and promote the organization. Additionally, I created and edited a few videos to help promote Bradley University's Homecoming Week!  As the Event Committee Co-Lead, I managed a group of volunteers not part of the Activities Council Executive Board through the event planning process through a series of bi-weekly meetings I held to create a series of successful events with 50+ attendees.
